sections.title: Title and attribution
sections.line: Crowley on the title (pdf p181); on Mars in Gemini (pdf p221).

quotes.quote: The Nine of Swords is called Cruelty.
The celestial ruler is Mars in Gemini

sections.title: Its place on the Tree
sections.line: Crowley on the number Nine, Yesod, and the central pillar of the Tree of Life (pdf p221).

quotes.quote: The number Nine, Yesod, brings back the Energy to the central pillar of the Tree of Life.

sections.title: What the card figures
sections.line: Crowley on the Swords and the stirring of heartless passions (pdf p221).

quotes.quote: The Swords no longer represent pure intellect so much as the automatic stirring of heartless passions.
